analyst.summary: PB Fintech (Policybazaar/Paisabazaar) is India's leading digital insurance and lending marketplace, and its FY26 growth was genuinely strong (revenue +36%, profit +90%, margin inflecting from 2% to 7-10%). However, return on equity remains modest at under 10% even after this scale-up, and the stock trades above 100 times earnings and over 10 times book value -- a valuation that requires continued rapid growth and further margin expansion to justify, neither of which is yet proven at the unit-economics level. We rate this a Sell on valuation grounds.
